cohort: S1/S2 DEV_COMPARE before FIRST LAYER KEEP/DROP
source_resolution: Exact State snapshot/version/cutoff pins recorded separately; no outcome-based source selection.
state_clock: Frozen BUY_INTENT generation/purchase decision cutoff before order/fill
acquisition_order: A authoritative saved BUY_INTENT State9 Primary snapshot
B saved frozen time series as-of under existing cutoff/order contract
C only if A/B absent: unchanged frozen kernel/profile/adapter on exact authorized pre-cutoff prefix; at most 322 ID
same_timestamp: Usable only with saved closed-bar->State-update->BUY_INTENT order evidence; neither timestamp equality alone nor unconditional 1-minute lag.
fallback: KEEP_STATE_UNAVAILABLE; abstention from exclusion, not Winner prediction; no execution-gate release
contradictions: Unresolved identity/time/R contradictions stop affected rows, never hidden with fallback.

P1.name: STATE9_EXCLUDE_SHARP_DROP
P1.rule: DROP iff state_usable=true AND Primary exactly SHARP_DROP; else KEEP

P2.name: STATE9_EXCLUDE_DROP_OR_SHARP_DROP
P2.rule: DROP iff state_usable=true AND Primary exactly DROP or SHARP_DROP; else KEEP

R_contract: Saved canonical cost-after Entry->Frozen EXIT/EOD R; exact percent numerator/denominator; no rounding before bucket, no new teacher
mass: Equal-weight Entry pp-sum; separate negative absolute and positive mass; R_UNKNOWN mass N/A; not yen/compound return/Final Equity/Capital
outputs: A2 State x all R counts
B all bands plus summaries and usable subset
E return mass and State-unavailable KEEP inner counts
F P2 minus P1 exactly usable DROP increment
audit: Same-author separate implementation from original ID/State/trace/R, not third-party blind audit; Fraction vs Decimal, membership vs correspondence table
tests: P1 DROP subset P2; additional exactly usable DROP
save_mode: append-only new diagnostic directory/branch; public aggregates/contracts/hashes only, private row-level evidence
stop: After fixed-two-rule diagnostics, independent audit, one reproduction, append-only save/readback and Japanese report. No next rule, fit, TEST or Capital.
